faqs.question: What deal options are available for Shampoo, Haircut, Balayage, Highlights, and More at Cactus Salon?
faqs.answer: This deal offers twelve options: Blowout with Deep-Conditioning Treatment (Valid Sunday–Wednesday or Any Day), Shampoo, Haircut, Blowout, and Deep-Conditioning Treatment (Valid Sunday–Wednesday or Any Day), Single Process Color Root Touchup with Deep-Conditioning Treatment and Blowout (Valid Sunday–Wednesday or Any Day), Single Process Color Root to Ends with Deep-Conditioning Treatment and Blowout (Valid Sunday–Wednesday or Any Day), Balayage or Full Highlights with Glaze and Blowout (Valid Sunday–Wednesday or Any Day), and Color Correction for Balayage or Full Highlights with Glaze and Blowout (Valid Sunday–Wednesday or Any Day).

faqs.question: What is the difference between the Sunday–Wednesday and Any Day options at Cactus Salon?
faqs.answer: Each service at Cactus Salon is available in two scheduling variations: one valid only Sunday through Wednesday, and one valid any day of the week. Buyers can choose the variation that best fits their schedule when selecting a deal option.

faqs.question: Does the haircut service at Cactus Salon include a wash and blowout?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Shampoo, Haircut, Blowout, and Deep-Conditioning Treatment option explicitly includes a hair wash and blowout as part of the service. Multiple customers have also confirmed that the salon's haircutting process includes a hair wash and blowout/style.

faqs.question: Which locations in New York can the Shampoo, Haircut, Balayage, Highlights, and More at Cactus Salon deal be redeemed at?
faqs.answer: This deal can be redeemed at four Cactus Salon locations in New York: 81 E Main St. in East Islip, NY 11730; 26 Vanderbilt Parkway in Commack, NY 11725; 2350 Nesconset Highway in Stony Brook, NY 11790; and 258 Main St. in Huntington, NY 11743.

faqs.question: Does Cactus Salon offer color correction services as part of this deal?
faqs.answer: Yes, Cactus Salon includes a Color Correction for Balayage or Full Highlights with Glaze and Blowout as one of the available deal options. This option is available in both a Sunday–Wednesday variation and an Any Day variation.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the Single Process Color Root Touchup and the Single Process Color Root to Ends options at Cactus Salon?
faqs.answer: The Single Process Color Root Touchup applies color only to the roots, while the Single Process Color Root to Ends applies color from the roots through the full length of the hair. Both options include a Deep-Conditioning Treatment and Blowout.

faqs.question: What types of hair coloring services are included in the Shampoo, Haircut, Balayage, Highlights, and More at Cactus Salon deal?
faqs.answer: The deal includes several coloring services: Single Process Color as a Root Touchup, Single Process Color Root to Ends, Balayage or Full Highlights with Glaze, and Color Correction for Balayage or Full Highlights with Glaze. All color options also include a Deep-Conditioning Treatment and Blowout.
